name_note: The species is published both as Lachnospira eligens and, earlier, as Eubacterium eligens; GTDB uses the Lachnospira name.

sentences.text: Lachnospira eligens, also published as Eubacterium eligens, is a gut bacterial species of the human colon.
A systematic review of in vitro fermentation reports that stimulation of Lachnospira and L. eligens is unique to pectic substrates among the fibres considered.
In synthetic co-cultures of human colonic bacteria grown on pectin, Lachnospira eligens DSM 3376 outcompeted Phocaeicola vulgatus and Segatella copri.
In faecal cultures from adults, production of indole-3-propionate was associated with this pectin-utilising species, which produced the precursor indole-3-lactate in vitro.
